title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform
description: Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system. The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data. At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day. As a Senior Software Engineer, Platform , you'll build the technical foundation that enables every engineering team at Choco to build, ship, and operate software reliably at scale. As we grow and serve increasingly demanding enterprise customers, our platform needs to evolve. You'll help improve the backend architecture, infrastructure, and developer tooling that keeps our systems scalable, reliable, and maintainable—while making engineers across the company more productive. This isn't a role for someone who wants to work on infrastructure in isolation. You'll own problems end-to-end, from understanding why they matter to designing, shipping, operating, and driving adoption of the right solution. What you'll do Design and build scalable backend systems, platform capabilities, and shared services used across Engineering. Improve developer experience through reusable tooling, frameworks, APIs, and automation. Operate and continuously improve distributed production systems with reliability, observability, and maintainability in mind. Partner closely with Product Engineering teams to solve complex technical problems and remove platform bottlenecks. Drive technical initiatives from architecture through implementation, rollout, and operational adoption. Make pragmatic engineering decisions that balance long-term quality with business priorities. Help prepare Choco's platform for the next stage of enterprise-scale growth. What you bring Significant experience building and operating backend systems at meaningful production scale. Strong experience with distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, scalable APIs, and cloud infrastructure. A track record of owning complex technical problems from discovery through implementation and production operation. Sound engineering judgement—you know when to improve existing systems, when to simplify, and when not to redesign. Experience with TypeScript is a plus. We're equally excited to meet exceptional engineers from Go, Java, Kotlin, or similar ecosystems who are motivated to work in TypeScript. What you get Work on digitalizing core operating systems for food distributors, automating orders, sales and payments in a system that still largely runs on calls and spreadsheets. Work with an AI product with proven product–market fit, already embedded in distributor workflows and directly affecting order accuracy, speed, and margins. Join a global team across 6 countries and 40+ nationalities, building a company that has raised $300M+ and reached unicorn status (~$1.2B valuation) with the ambition to define this category end-to-end. In return, you get real ownership, equity, and the support to do your best work, including competitive compensation, health and wellbeing support, and long-term benefits like a sabbatical (all localized by office). Collaborate with people who want to own outcomes in a messy, real-world system and make it work at scale. If you want to work on real problems, take ownership, and raise the bar, we should talk. Choco is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. We are committed to ensuring that our technology is available and accessible to everyone. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Ich bin Julia, Organisationspsychologin und Gründerin, und suche die dritte Person im Gründungsteam. Stand heute:

  • laufende Piloten in Industrie, Tech und Dienstleistung
  • Sieg beim Harbour Founder Summit
  • ein Platz im Finale des Startup World Cup in San Francisco, November 2026

Produkt und Wissenschaft liegen bei mir, Technik bei der Tech-Rolle, das Geschäft bei dir.

Aufgaben

Pipeline und Partnerschaften aufbauen. Zielgruppe: Unternehmen im DACH-Raum mit vielen Erstgesprächen und spürbarer Fluktuation. Ansprechpartner: CHROs und Heads of Talent Acquisition, dazu ATS-Anbieter und Beratungen.

Aus den Pilotpartnern zahlende Kunden machen, inklusive Onboarding.

Preise, Pakete, Verträge und die großen Fragen: Rechtsform, Beteiligung, Steuern, Finanzierung. Die entscheiden wir zu zweit.

Qualifikation

Du hast B2B-Abschlüsse selbst getragen, von der ersten Mail bis zur Unterschrift. Wie viele Berufsjahre dahinterstehen, zähle ich nicht mit. Erzähl mir lieber von einem dieser Abschlüsse.

Du arbeitest mit KI, weil es dich schneller macht. Recherche, Vorbereitung und Nachfassen baust du dir als eigenen Ablauf, neue Werkzeuge erschließt du dir ohne Anleitung. Mein eigenes Setup zeige ich dir gern.

Du führst gern schwierige Runden. Wir verkaufen ein System, das die KI-Verordnung als Hochrisiko einstuft. Betriebsrat und Datenschutzbeauftragte sitzen also mit am Tisch.

Du gehst gern auf Menschen zu, auf der Bühne, am Messestand, unter Fremden. Du sagst, was du denkst, offen und direkt, im Team und mir gegenüber. So arbeiten wir. Einen verlorenen Abschluss erklärst du, ohne ihn jemandem zuzuschieben, einen gewonnenen, ohne ihn allein für dich zu reklamieren. Und du willst eine Sache über Jahre groß machen.

Sprache und Ort: Deutsch verhandlungssicher, Englisch für die Technik. Basis ist Hamburg, House of AI, mit Reisen zu Kund:innen. Remote geht, Sitz in der EU.

Benefits

Stipendium über zwölf Monate. Mit Hochschulabschluss 2.500 Euro im Monat, promoviert 3.000, mit Berufsabschluss 2.000, als Studierende:r 1.000. Ausgezahlt wird der volle Betrag ohne Abzüge.

Beteiligung im niedrigen einstelligen Prozentbereich. Virtuell, mit Option auf Umwandlung in echte Anteile, vier Jahre Vesting, zwölf Monate Cliff, Start an deinem ersten Arbeitstag, Gevestetes bleibt dir.

Dein Erfolg zahlt auf deinen Anteil ein. Jeder Neukunde, den du selbst gewinnst, bringt eine zusätzliche Tranche, gekoppelt an den Vertragswert. Eine Auszahlung in Geld kommt dazu, sobald der Förderrahmen sie zulässt.

Einen Bereich, den du allein verantwortest.

Und das solltest du wissen, bevor du dich bewirbst:

Die Rolle wäre zwölf Monate über das EXIST-Gründungsstipendium finanziert. Der Antrag ist geschrieben und geht raus, sobald das Gründungsteam steht. Bewilligt ist nichts.

Bis zum 01.12.2026 fließt kein Gehalt. Dafür beginnt deine Beteiligung mit deiner Zusage. Bis zum Förderbeginn bauen wir auf: Pipeline, Gespräche, Preismodell. Die Abschlüsse folgen danach. Den Umfang legen wir so fest, dass du daneben Geld verdienen kannst. Vor dem Start unterschreiben wir eine Vereinbarung über Umfang, Beteiligung und Rechte, mit allen Zahlen. Ab dem 01.12. verlangt die Förderung Vollzeit, daneben höchstens 20 Stunden bezahlte Nebentätigkeit im Monat.

Dein Name steht im Antrag. Dafür brauche ich einen Lebenslauf und eine Kopie deines Abschlusszeugnisses.

Kommt die Förderung nicht, steigst du reduziert neben etwas anderem ein, deine Beteiligung bleibt, und wir organisieren die Finanzierung anders.

So läuft es ab:

Bis Sonntag, 16.08.2026: Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, dazu je drei bis fünf Sätze zu einem selbst getragenen Abschluss und zu einem Ablauf, den du dir mit KI gebaut hast. Kein Anschreiben.

  1. Erstgespräch, 20 Minuten per Video: sobald es dir passt, spätestens in der Woche vom 17.08. Ich melde mich innerhalb von 24 Stunden nach deiner Bewerbung.
  2. Direkt danach führst du selbst ein aimea-Interview, dasselbe Format, das Unternehmen bei uns einsetzen. Allein, wann es dir passt, mit eigenem Bericht. Es entscheidet nichts für sich, und du kannst es auslassen.
  3. Zweites Gespräch plus ein halber Tag an einem echten Lead, mit deinen Werkzeugen, bis zum 22.08. In Hamburg, wenn es geht, sonst per Video.
  4. Bis Montag, 24.08.2026: Entscheidung von beiden Seiten. Danach geht der Antrag raus, Förderbeginn geplant zum 01.12.2026.

Wir sind zu dritt, wenn du dabei bist, und alles, was danach kommt, bauen wir gemeinsam. Wenn dir das gefällt, schreib mir.

Julia Kurkowski, Founder & CEO, aimea

title: SEO Automation Lead (w/m/d)
description: Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert. Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen. Deine Aufgaben Du entwickelst und verantwortest unsere ganzheitliche SEO-Strategie von Technical SEO über Content bis hin zu Offpage-Maßnahmen – und machst SEO zu einem zentralen Wachstumstreiber für Enpal. Du führst und entwickelst das SEO-Team fachlich und disziplinarisch weiter, förderst individuelle Stärken und schaffst eine Kultur aus Eigenverantwortung, Lernen und messbaren Erfolgen. Du steuerst die SEO-Roadmap strategisch, setzt klare Prioritäten und orchestrierst alle Maßnahmen entlang messbarer KPIs mit direktem Business Impact. Du arbeitest eng mit Communications, Product, Tech und Design zusammen und treibst technische wie inhaltliche SEO-Projekte partnerschaftlich und lösungsorientiert voran. Du verantwortest zentrale Technical-SEO-Themen wie Crawlability, Indexierung, Site-Architektur, Core Web Vitals und strukturierte Daten und sorgst für eine nachhaltig skalierbare technische Basis. Du entwickelst eine datengetriebene Content- und Linkbuilding-Strategie mit Fokus auf E-E-A-T, Keyword-Cluster und organisches Wachstum, die unsere Sichtbarkeit und Autorität kontinuierlich stärkt. Du entwickelst eine zukunftsgerichtete GEO-Strategie (Generative Engine Optimization) zur Sichtbarkeit in KI-gestützten Suchmaschinen (ChatGPT, Perplexity etc.) inkl. Content-Optimierung für LLM-Zitationen. Du bleibst am Puls der Zeit, erkennst Trends und neue Entwicklungen im SEO- und Marketing-Umfeld frühzeitig und nutzt sie, um zu experimentieren, zu lernen und neue Opportunities zu erschließen. Du analysierst kontinuierlich Performance-Daten, leitest strategische Handlungsempfehlungen ab und kommunizierst Erfolge, Learnings und nächste Schritte transparent an das C-Level. Dein Profil Du bringst 5–7 Jahre SEO-Erfahrung mit und kannst nachweisliche Erfolge in der Steigerung organischer Sichtbarkeit, Traffic-Wachstum und Lead-Generierung vorweisen. Du hast mindestens 2–3 Jahre Führungserfahrung – idealerweise beim Aufbau, der Entwicklung oder Skalierung von SEO-Teams – und verstehst es, Menschen zu befähigen und mitzunehmen. Du verfügst über tiefgehende Expertise in allen SEO-Disziplinen: Technical SEO, On-Page, Content-Strategie und Offpage/Linkbuilding – und weißt, wie du diese strategisch miteinander verzahnst. Du arbeitest sicher mit gängigen SEO-Tools wie Google Search Console, Ahrefs, Sistrix, Google Analytics, Audisto oder Screaming Frog. Du hast Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Developer-Teams und bringst ein solides technisches Verständnis mit (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, APIs). Du kennst dich mit KI-basiertem Arbeiten und GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) aus und hast bereits Erfahrung mit der Optimierung für KI-gestützte Suchmaschinen, LLMs und AI-Overviews gesammelt. Du arbeitest unternehmerisch, denkst analytisch, triffst datenbasierte Entscheidungen und richtest dein Handeln konsequent an messbarem Impact aus. Du bist eine kommunikationsstarke, strukturierte und proaktive Persönlichkeit mit Hands-on-Mentalität und fließenden Deutsch- und Englischkenntnissen. Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️ Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to rapid growth, we are seeking a Technical Program Manager with an AI/ML background to join our team in Berlin. You will be a key driver of technical cohesion, bridging the gap between our research and the physical implementation of next-generation materials.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building and executing the program management framework that accelerates AI/ML frontier research and platform capability development, which is critical for translating scientific objectives into real-world, scalable materials breakthroughs.

As a member of our growing team of TPMs, you will work closely with our technical teams on internal initiatives and also manage high-stakes customer projects. Your main focus initially will be coordinating complex technical campaigns in frontier AI/ML research focused on developing novel materials, and over time you will likely get involved in establishing more sophisticated, scalable processes for model development lifecycles.



What You Will Do

Program Leadership & Research Integration

  • Lead internal technical programs across AI/ML model development, frontier research, data workflows, and machine learning infrastructure, acting as the connective tissue between AI researchers and materials scientists.

  • Translate scientific and business objectives into executable plans, aligning commercial, research and engineering teams.

  • Close the loop between experimental results and the AI research cycle, translating lab findings back into the model development process to continuously improve accuracy and accelerate discovery.

  • Own planning and delivery of projects; calculating compute, managing resources & dependencies, mapping out timelines, and managing risks to ensure successful outcomes.

Partner & Customer Collaboration

  • Lead technical programs with industry partners and research institutions, serving as a primary program contact for our external partners during the execution and delivery of projects.

  • Facilitate technical discussions between internal teams and external stakeholders.

  • Drive project scoping and proposal writing in collaboration with the Partnerships and technical teams.

  • Manage joint development initiatives and coordinate customer pilot programs from conception through to deployment.

Process & Operations

  • Work closely with the rest of the global TPM team to refine scalable processes.

  • Implement metrics for tracking technical milestones and program outcomes.

  • Coordinate compliance and regulatory considerations across programs.

  • Support intellectual property (IP) and scientific publication processes.

  • Foster interdisciplinary team culture and own change management to successfully scale the organisation.

  • Use data to drive continuous improvements to internal and customer-facing processes.


Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You possess a strong background in AI/ML and/or a related Natural Science field.

  • Proven experience as a Technical Program Manager specifically within the AI/ML domain, including a deep understanding of model architecture, cloud computing best practices and the software development lifecycle.

  • Strong leadership and facilitation capabilities for managing cross-functional teams.

  • The ability to navigate high levels of ambiguity and maintain cohesion across multi-disciplinary teams (AI, Chemistry, and Engineering).

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence both highly technical researchers and non-technical partners at varying levels of seniority.

  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills with comfort navigating ambiguity and changing priorities.



Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Experience with molecular simulation software, quantum chemistry packages, or cheminformatics tools.

  • Practical experience or an academic background in Materials Science, Experimental Chemistry, or Physics.

  • Hands-on experience with high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructure or scientific data management.



Additional Considerations

title: Schülerjob / Minijob (m/w/d)
description: Deine Rolle Die meisten Schülerjobs zeigen dir wenig: Regale einräumen, Spülmaschine, immer derselbe Handgriff. Wir sind ein Beratungsunternehmen mit fast 15 Millionen Euro Umsatz, über 100 Mitarbeitern und dem Anspruch, Steuerberatung grundlegend zu modernisieren. Und auch als Schüler im Minijob bist du Teil davon — nicht am Rand, sondern mittendrin. Du bist Schüler und suchst einen Nebenjob, der mehr ist als Taschengeld: Du packst mit an, damit der Laden läuft — in einem Umfeld, das digital arbeitet, in moderne Technik investiert und in dem du Dinge siehst und lernst, die dir in keinem anderen Schülerjob begegnen. Du unterstützt unser Team in Aalen bei Technik, Digitalisierung und Organisation. Wenn beide Seiten überzeugt sind, kann daraus mehr werden — ein Praktikum, eine Ausbildung oder ein duales Studium. Deine Verantwortung Technik & Arbeitsplätze Du richtest Arbeitsplätze ein — Monitore, Laptops, Docking Stations — damit neue Kollegen am ersten Tag loslegen können. Du verwaltest und inventarisierst unsere Hardware und behältst den Überblick, welches Gerät wo im Einsatz ist. Digitalisierung Du scannst Unterlagen ein und legst sie sauber in der digitalen Ablage ab. Du hilfst mit, Papierprozesse abzulösen — jeder Ordner, den du digitalisierst, verschwindet dauerhaft aus dem Büro. Organisation im Büro Du bearbeitest die Post, kümmerst dich um Büromaterial und bereitest Meetingräume vor. Je nach Interesse bekommst du Einblicke in die Finanzbuchführung und in interne Projekte. Das bringst du mit Erfahrung & Track Record Du bist Schüler — ob Realschule, Gymnasium oder Berufsschule ist uns weniger wichtig als deine Einstellung. Berufserfahrung brauchst du keine. Was zählt: Du bist zuverlässig, pünktlich und hältst, was du zusagst. Auch wenn du noch nie in einem Büro gearbeitet hast, bist du ausdrücklich eingeladen — wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett. Wer anpackt und mitdenkt, passt zu uns. Skills & Arbeitsweise Du gehst sorgfältig mit Technik und Unterlagen um. Du arbeitest selbstständig — wenn etwas unklar ist, fragst du, statt zu warten. Mindset & Persönlichkeit Du hast Eigeninitiative: Du siehst, was zu tun ist, und machst es. Du bist neugierig darauf, wie ein digital arbeitendes Unternehmen von innen funktioniert. Was du bei uns nicht finden wirst Kein Abstell-Job am Rand. Auch als Schüler im Minijob bist du Teil des Teams — mit echten Aufgaben, die das Unternehmen braucht. Kein „wir geben dir Arbeit, wenn jemand frei ist, dich anzuleiten“-Setup. Du bekommst verbindliche Aufgabenpakete mit klarem Anleiter, nicht nur Lückenfüllung. Kein „irgendwann darfst du mal eigenständig arbeiten“. Bei uns gilt von Tag eins: Du machst, du trägst, du wirst korrigiert, wenn nötig — aber du wartest nicht. Kein verstaubtes Büro mit Papierbergen und Faxgerät. Wir investieren in moderne Technik und digitale Prozesse — du arbeitest mit Geräten und Tools, die dir in keinem anderen Schülerjob begegnen. FAQ 1. Was ist Vogel — und wo arbeitet ihr? Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands — Familienunternehmen seit 1959, aus Aalen — und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir wachsen an mehreren Standorten: in Aalen/Ostwürttemberg als gewachsenem Stammsitz und in München als neuem Hub. An beiden suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen — von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den strategischen Teams, die die Plattform bauen. 2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen? Bewusst breit — und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Wir kalibrieren ausschließlich am Markt — zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen. 3. Wie viel — und wie — wird bei Vogel gearbeitet? Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen — Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem. 4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung? Schlank, schnell, transparent — und nach Profil gestaffelt. Für Einstiegsrollen (Praktikum, Werkstudium, Berufseinstieg) genügen in der Regel zwei Gespräche und eine kurze Arbeitsprobe; erfahrene Rollen laufen etwas ausführlicher. Bei ausgewählten Senior-Rollen prüfen wir, künftig einen gemeinsamen Arbeitstag einzubauen, damit beide Seiten sich besser kennenlernen. Immer gilt: getaktete Termine, zügige Entscheidung, substanzielles Feedback — unabhängig vom Ausgang. 5. Wie funktioniert die variable Vergütung? Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. raw.title: Schülerjob / Minijob (m/w/d)
raw.description:
Deine Rolle

Die meisten Schülerjobs zeigen dir wenig: Regale einräumen, Spülmaschine, immer derselbe Handgriff.

Wir sind ein Beratungsunternehmen mit fast 15 Millionen Euro Umsatz, über 100 Mitarbeitern und dem Anspruch, Steuerberatung grundlegend zu modernisieren. Und auch als Schüler im Minijob bist du Teil davon — nicht am Rand, sondern mittendrin.

Du bist Schüler und suchst einen Nebenjob, der mehr ist als Taschengeld: Du packst mit an, damit der Laden läuft — in einem Umfeld, das digital arbeitet, in moderne Technik investiert und in dem du Dinge siehst und lernst, die dir in keinem anderen Schülerjob begegnen.

Du unterstützt unser Team in Aalen bei Technik, Digitalisierung und Organisation. Wenn beide Seiten überzeugt sind, kann daraus mehr werden — ein Praktikum, eine Ausbildung oder ein duales Studium.

Deine Verantwortung

Technik & Arbeitsplätze

  • Du richtest Arbeitsplätze ein — Monitore, Laptops, Docking Stations — damit neue Kollegen am ersten Tag loslegen können.

  • Du verwaltest und inventarisierst unsere Hardware und behältst den Überblick, welches Gerät wo im Einsatz ist.

Digitalisierung

  • Du scannst Unterlagen ein und legst sie sauber in der digitalen Ablage ab.

  • Du hilfst mit, Papierprozesse abzulösen — jeder Ordner, den du digitalisierst, verschwindet dauerhaft aus dem Büro.

Organisation im Büro

  • Du bearbeitest die Post, kümmerst dich um Büromaterial und bereitest Meetingräume vor.

  • Je nach Interesse bekommst du Einblicke in die Finanzbuchführung und in interne Projekte.

Das bringst du mit

Erfahrung & Track Record

  • Du bist Schüler — ob Realschule, Gymnasium oder Berufsschule ist uns weniger wichtig als deine Einstellung.

  • Berufserfahrung brauchst du keine. Was zählt: Du bist zuverlässig, pünktlich und hältst, was du zusagst.

  • Auch wenn du noch nie in einem Büro gearbeitet hast, bist du ausdrücklich eingeladen — wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett. Wer anpackt und mitdenkt, passt zu uns.

Skills & Arbeitsweise

  • Du gehst sorgfältig mit Technik und Unterlagen um.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig — wenn etwas unklar ist, fragst du, statt zu warten.

Mindset & Persönlichkeit

  • Du hast Eigeninitiative: Du siehst, was zu tun ist, und machst es.

  • Du bist neugierig darauf, wie ein digital arbeitendes Unternehmen von innen funktioniert.

Was du bei uns nicht finden wirst

  • Kein Abstell-Job am Rand. Auch als Schüler im Minijob bist du Teil des Teams — mit echten Aufgaben, die das Unternehmen braucht.

  • Kein „wir geben dir Arbeit, wenn jemand frei ist, dich anzuleiten“-Setup. Du bekommst verbindliche Aufgabenpakete mit klarem Anleiter, nicht nur Lückenfüllung.

  • Kein „irgendwann darfst du mal eigenständig arbeiten“. Bei uns gilt von Tag eins: Du machst, du trägst, du wirst korrigiert, wenn nötig — aber du wartest nicht.

  • Kein verstaubtes Büro mit Papierbergen und Faxgerät. Wir investieren in moderne Technik und digitale Prozesse — du arbeitest mit Geräten und Tools, die dir in keinem anderen Schülerjob begegnen.

FAQ

1. Was ist Vogel — und wo arbeitet ihr?

Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands — Familienunternehmen seit 1959, aus Aalen — und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir wachsen an mehreren Standorten: in Aalen/Ostwürttemberg als gewachsenem Stammsitz und in München als neuem Hub. An beiden suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen — von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den strategischen Teams, die die Plattform bauen.

2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen?

Bewusst breit — und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Wir kalibrieren ausschließlich am Markt — zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen.

3. Wie viel — und wie — wird bei Vogel gearbeitet?

Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen — Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem.

4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung?

Schlank, schnell, transparent — und nach Profil gestaffelt. Für Einstiegsrollen (Praktikum, Werkstudium, Berufseinstieg) genügen in der Regel zwei Gespräche und eine kurze Arbeitsprobe; erfahrene Rollen laufen etwas ausführlicher. Bei ausgewählten Senior-Rollen prüfen wir, künftig einen gemeinsamen Arbeitstag einzubauen, damit beide Seiten sich besser kennenlernen. Immer gilt: getaktete Termine, zügige Entscheidung, substanzielles Feedback — unabhängig vom Ausgang.

5. Wie funktioniert die variable Vergütung?

Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Erwartungswert bei guter Leistung — du erfüllst die Anforderungen, setzt eigene Akzente, bestehst den Keeper Test — liegt bei rund 50 % des Maximums; der Maximalbonus ist nicht der Normalfall. Im Fokus steht eine ganzheitliche Beurteilung durch deine Führungskraft: Ownership, Qualität, Lernkurve, Zusammenarbeit, Impact.

6. Wie entwickle ich mich — welche Karrierewege gibt es?

Zwei aktive Wege: Mastery (fachliche Tiefe, Expertenlaufbahn) und Pioneer (Führung, Management). Die Richtung wählst du nach dem Onboarding, meist in Jahr 1–3. Berufseinstieg ist kein Sonderweg, sondern der frühe Teil derselben Strecke — vom Werkstudenten oder Praktikanten zum Associate, für die Besten ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren.

7. Team, Kultur, Urlaub?

Ein gemeinsames Mittagessen ist ein offenes tägliches Angebot — keine Pflicht; wer mag, kommt dazu, essen kann jeder jederzeit. Dazu Abendessen, Social Events und Offsites in regelmäßigem Rhythmus — nicht als Pflichtprogramm, sondern weil ein gutes Team auch abseits der Arbeit Zeit teilt. Benefits: durchdacht und substanziell, nicht symbolisch. Urlaub: 28 Tage.

8. Ich kenne jemanden — gibt es einen Empfehlungsbonus?

Ja — 2.500 EUR für jede erfolgreich besetzte Stelle (keine Praktika). Kurzer Kontext reicht: an wen du denkst, für welche Rolle, warum. Muss nicht perfekt sitzen, aber substanziell sein.

Compensation: €15 per hour

We are actively building our talent pipeline for upcoming growth across the Scientific Data Architect team. Please note: This is an Expression of Interest advert, and there is no active vacancy at this exact moment. However, we anticipate opening formal roles in the coming months and want to connect with great talent early.

About TetraScience

TetraScience is the Scientific Data and AI Company building Tetra OS, the operating system for scientific intelligence. We help the world’s leading life sciences firms turn fragmented scientific data into AI-native assets and scientific workflows that accelerate discovery, development, and manufacturing. TetraScience’s growing ecosystem of strategic partners includes NVIDIA, Databricks, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Snowflake, Google, and Microsoft.

In connection with your candidacy, you will be asked to carefully review “The Tetra Way,” authored by our CEO, Patrick Grady; it is impossible to overstate the importance of this document, and you should take it literally as you decide whether our mission, culture, and expectations are right for you.

Who You Are

You are a product-minded, outcome-obsessed driver of technical scientific solutions.

You a high velocity self-starter. You refuse to let uncertainty obstruct your path to designing and building solutions.

You roll up your sleeves, try things out, and get things done. You do not hesitate to prototype, demo, and build in order to accelerate delivery of products for your end users.

You thrive in environments where you can collaborate with scientists, product managers, and engineers to transform complex scientific data into actionable outcomes. Your ability to engage with scientists and business leaders alike makes you a key player in maximizing the value of scientific data.

With rich experience applying cutting edge data methodologies to the biopharma R&D domain, you bridge understanding between present-day pain points and generalizable solutions.

You are an insatiable learner, with a track record of deeply learning new tools, methods, and domains.

You fundamentally embody the principles of extreme ownership and have a demonstrated history of building extensible data models and applications for Biopharma end users to maximize value from their data via analysis and integration with AI/ML.

This role will require extreme self-discipline and determination as we forge a category that will fundamentally and forever change the life science industry.

What You Have Done

  • PhD or Masters with a number of years proven industry experience in life sciences  with extensive domain knowledge in drug discovery (target ID through lead optimization), preclinical development, CMC (all drug modalities), or product quality testing.
  • Proven track record of defining, designing, prototyping, and implementing productized AI/ML-driven use cases in cloud environments
  • Collaborated with cross-functional teams, including product managers, software engineers, and scientific stakeholders.
  • Performed extensive exploratory data analysis and workflow optimization to enable scientific outcomes not previously possible.
  • Engaged diverse audiences, from scientists to executive stakeholders using your excellent communication and storytelling abilities.
  • Advised scientists in a consulting capacity to further research, development, and quality testing outcomes.

Requirements

What You Will Do

  • You will be a critical team member in a unique partnership to industrialize Scientific AI. As such, you will engage directly with customers onsite a couple of days per week in the Frankfurt Region, building strong relationships, deeply understanding their scientific data challenges and requirements, and accelerating solutions.
  • Design and implement extensible, reusable data models that efficiently capture and organize scientific data for scientific use cases, ensuring scalability and future adaptability.
  • Translate scientific data workflows into robust solutions leveraging the Tetra Data Platform.
  • Own, scope, prototype, and implement solutions including:
    • Data model design (tabular & JSON)
    • Python-based parser development.
    • Lab software (e.g., ELN/LIMS) integration via APIs.
    • Data visualization and app development in Python (using app frameworks like Streamlit and plotting tools like holoviews and Plotly) 
    • Collaborate with Scientific Business Analysts (SBAs), customer scientists and applied AI engineers to develop and deploy models (ML, AI, mechanistic, statistical, hybrid)
    • Programmatically interrogating proprietary instrument output files.
  • Dynamically iterate with scientific end users and technical stakeholders to rapidly drive solution development and adoption through regular demos and meetings
  • Proactively communicate implementation progress and deliver demos to customer stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with the product team to build and prioritize our roadmap by understanding customers’ pain points within and outside Tetra Data Platform.
  • Rapidly learn new technologies (e.g., new AWS services or scientific analysis applications) to develop and troubleshoot use cases
  • Business proficiency of German required (C1 level)
  • Work on client site on average 3 days per week

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary and equity in a fast-growing company.
  • Supportive, team-oriented culture of continuous improvement.
  • Generous paid time off (PTO).
  • Flexible working arrangements - Remote work when not at Customer Sites

We are not currently providing visa sponsorship for this position.

We are actively building our talent pipeline for upcoming growth across the Scientific Data Architect team. Please note: This is an Expression of Interest advert, and there is no active vacancy at this exact moment. However, we anticipate opening formal roles in the coming months and want to connect with great talent early.

About TetraScience

TetraScience is the Scientific Data and AI Company building Tetra OS, the operating system for scientific intelligence. We help the world’s leading life sciences firms turn fragmented scientific data into AI-native assets and scientific workflows that accelerate discovery, development, and manufacturing. TetraScience’s growing ecosystem of strategic partners includes NVIDIA, Databricks, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Snowflake, Google, and Microsoft.

In connection with your candidacy, you will be asked to carefully review “The Tetra Way,” authored by our CEO, Patrick Grady; it is impossible to overstate the importance of this document, and you should take it literally as you decide whether our mission, culture, and expectations are right for you.

Who You Are

You are a product-minded, outcome-obsessed driver of technical scientific solutions.

You a high velocity self-starter. You refuse to let uncertainty obstruct your path to designing and building solutions.

You roll up your sleeves, try things out, and get things done. You do not hesitate to prototype, demo, and build in order to accelerate delivery of products for your end users.

You thrive in environments where you can collaborate with scientists, product managers, and engineers to transform complex scientific data into actionable outcomes. Your ability to engage with scientists and business leaders alike makes you a key player in maximizing the value of scientific data.

With rich experience applying cutting edge data methodologies to the biopharma R&D domain, you bridge understanding between present-day pain points and generalizable solutions.

You are an insatiable learner, with a track record of deeply learning new tools, methods, and domains.

You fundamentally embody the principles of extreme ownership and have a demonstrated history of building extensible data models and applications for Biopharma end users to maximize value from their data via analysis and integration with AI/ML.

This role will require extreme self-discipline and determination as we forge a category that will fundamentally and forever change the life science industry.

What You Have Done

description: Deine Aufgaben Als Strategy Manager Krankentransport (m/w/d) verantwortest du Business Development, Go-to-Market und die Vermarktung unserer Software für Krankentransportdienstleister. Du ergänzt unser Produktteam – zwei erfahrene Product Owner mit tiefer technischer und marktseitiger Expertise – um die Themen Business Development, Go-to-Market und Marketing und übernimmst eigenständig die Schnittstelle zwischen Produkt und Sales. Dein Ziel: Unsere Software für Krankentransporteure erfolgreich im Markt zu positionieren und eigenständig neue Geschäftspotenziale zu erschließen – von der Business-Case-Entwicklung über Kooperationsverhandlungen bis zur erfolgreichen Markteinführung. Go-to-Market: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Produktteam die Go-to-Market-Strategie für neue Produktthemen und verantwortest deren erfolgreiche Markteinführung. Business Development: Du identifizierst neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und Verticals, bewertest sie anhand von Zahlen und entwickelst daraus belastbare Business Cases. Partnerschaften & Kooperationen: Du führst eigenständig Kooperationsverhandlungen mit Partnern aus (Groß-)Unternehmen und baust strategische Partnerschaften auf. Schnittstelle Produkt & Sales: Du agierst als Bindeglied zwischen unserem Produktteam und Sales und übersetzt Produktthemen in überzeugende Vermarktungs- und Vertriebsargumente. Business Case & Priorisierung: Du bewertest Geschäftschancen anhand von Zahlen und priorisierst sie nach Kundennutzen, Geschäftspotenzial und Aufwand. Projektsteuerung: Du treibst deine Projekte eigenständig und dynamisch voran – von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung im Markt. Dein Profil Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Marketing oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

We seek a Product Manager to join our Courier and Delivery Experience (CDX) team. This role will focus on ensuring world-class courier and consumer delivery experiences while continually evolving the delivery process with a future-oriented mindset. The Courier and Delivery Experience team owns the experiences that elevate every Wolt delivery, from the moment a courier opens the app to every order they accept, all the way to dropping an order off at the customer's doorstep. The team sits at the intersection of a multi-sided marketplace product, real-world operations, and safety, and the work directly moves how reliable Wolt feels to consumers and how satisfied our couriers are when delivering.

You will play a crucial role in shaping the courier experience, ensuring that our couriers feel valued and supported while enhancing the efficiency of deliveries. By blending operational expertise with a deep understanding of courier needs, you will improve the user journey from onboarding couriers to completing deliveries. From designing new features that boost courier satisfaction to refining delivery processes, your work will contribute to key metrics across courier engagement, performance, and satisfaction. You will also be influential in shaping the evolution of the live delivery experience for our courier partners, the merchant courier interaction at pickup and the consumer courier interaction at the doorstep via the Courier app surfaces. 

The ideal candidate will have an exceptional track record in product management, with proven success in working with cross-functional teams across engineering, design, product, and operations. You will define the vision and roadmap for courier and delivery experiences across multiple projects. Working in partnership with business stakeholders, you will also collaborate on cross-team initiatives, contributing to the broader business strategy while ensuring a deep understanding of the courier experience.

Join us in shaping the future of delivery, where every delivery is an opportunity for delight and loyalty.

Our humble expectations

You could come to this role from various backgrounds, but ideally, you bring:

  • Several years of experience in product management, specializing in consumer-facing products
  • Expertise in developing user-centric products, with the ability to address complex user experience-related challenges.
  • Demonstrated expertise in supporting cross-functional teams and fostering operational excellence in fast-paced, high-demand industries.
  • Proven track record in building products influencing cross-functional teams, including engineering, data, design, and operations.
  • High ownership and collaborative capabilities, making thoughtful decisions, and focusing on product details to ensure execution aligns with the vision.
  • Strong ability to define, execute, and measure meaningful OKRs, ensuring alignment with company-wide goals and fostering bottom-up alignment from your team.
  • Ability to focus on the bigger picture, creating solutions that benefit couriers, operations, and customer experiences across the organization.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with diverse internal teams and external partners, while confidently engaging with leadership in a high-visibility role

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

The compensation will be a negotiable combination of monthly pay and DoorDash RSUs. The latter makes it exceptionally easy to be excited about our company growing and doing well, as you'll own a piece of the pie.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

description: <p>At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading meal kit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalised food experiences to millions of households worldwide.</p> <p>Work with HelloFresh in Berlin and its HelloTech organisation — HelloFresh's global technology backbone with more than 1,000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat and seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.</p> <p>Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalisation logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain</p> <h2><strong>About the role: What's in the box</strong></h2> <p>Good Chop is HelloFresh Group's premium meat and seafood subscription — American-sourced, direct-to-consumer, operating in a competitive market where the experience is the product. The premium positioning is intentional and the aesthetic bar is high.</p> <p>This is a full-ownership role in a startup-paced environment. You'll partner with Product and Engineering on a cross-functional squad — the PM owns the roadmap, you own the UX direction. UX here is a strategic input, not a downstream service.</p> <p>You'll bring T-shaped fluency in research and content — enough to drive lightweight discovery independently and contribute meaningfully to both disciplines. For deeper research and content work, you'll partner with HelloFresh's central UX research and strategy team and content design experts.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do: The Recipe</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Consumer UX:&nbsp;</strong>Lead design from concept to shipped product, maintaining accountability for the full consumer experience across touchpoints. You hold a high bar for quality at every stage — from early framing through final execution.</li> <li><strong>Strategy and roadmap influence: </strong>Frame problems before they become briefs. Bring evidence-backed consumer insight into squad planning — challenge priorities, surface opportunities, and influence what gets built. You're a strategic partner in roadmap conversations, contributing to direction from the start.</li> <li><strong>Craft and execution: </strong>Hold a high personal bar across UI, interaction design, motion, and UX writing — and raise the standard within the squad. Use animation and motion as intentional tools, not decoration.</li> <li><strong>Research fluency: </strong>Bring enough research depth to frame questions, run lightweight studies independently, and collaborate meaningfully with HelloFresh's central UX research and strategy team on more complex investigations. Translate findings into design direction — you're a research partner, not a passive consumer of insights.</li> <li><strong>AI-native workflow: </strong>Use AI across the full workflow: synthesis, discovery, rapid prototyping, design-to-code. A working method that lets you move faster and think sharper.</li> <li><strong>Content and UX writing: </strong>Bring enough content fluency to contribute meaningfully to UX copy and brief content design experts when deeper support is needed. Clarity and precision in language are part of your craft bar.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring: The Ingredients</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Consumer instinct: </strong>You've worked on consumer-facing products and you understand how real people make decisions — to try something, to stay, to leave. You think about retention as a design problem, not a churn-rate metric. Subscription context is a plus. What matters is whether you think about the full lifecycle, not just the next feature.</li> <li><strong>Strategic range: </strong>You define the problem before designing the solution. You've pushed back on a brief, reframed a PM's question, or changed a roadmap priority through evidence. You bring design into the strategy conversation — not because you were invited, but because you built the case.</li> <li><strong>Craft mastery: </strong>High-fidelity UI, interaction design, motion, micro-interaction, UX writing — you hold a high personal bar across all of it. Figma mastery is non-negotiable. You understand front-end constraints well enough to have credible conversations with engineers without hand-holding.</li> <li><strong>Autonomous operation: </strong>You're comfortable owning the full width of the work — strategy, research, execution, content, and stakeholder communication — and energised by the scope that comes with it.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder communication and alignment:&nbsp;</strong>You present clearly, facilitate alignment across functions, and can run a workshop as confidently as you can ship a screen. You adapt under scrutiny and make the case for your decisions with evidence, not opinion.</li> <li><strong>Research fluency: </strong>You can frame a research question, run a lightweight study, and translate findings into design direction without needing a researcher to drive the process. You know when to go deeper, how to collaborate with research experts, and how to brief an agency when the question demands it.</li> <li><strong>AI-native in practice: </strong>Active use of AI tools in live project work — synthesis, discovery, prototyping, design-to-code. This is how you work, not something you're working towards.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We Offer: The Toppings</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.</li> <li>Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.</li> <li>Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.</li> <li>Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.</li> <li>Invest in your growth with a German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.</li> <li>Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>#PRODUCT<br>#DESIGN</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Frontend Platform Engineer
description: The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve: Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register . We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. 🎯 Your main goal will be to design and evolve the frontend platform foundations that power n8n’s workflow-building experience, enabling product engineers and the open-source community to ship complex, reliable, and high-performance user experiences across cloud and self-hosted deployments. As part of the team, you’ll take ownership of core frontend platform domains and help shape the architecture behind one of the most flexible automation products in the market: Frontend platform architecture Own and evolve core frontend platform primitives that make n8n’s workflow builder scalable, extensible, and maintainable. Strengthen platform contracts such as plugin systems, extension points, and frontend developer experience. Help modularize a large, evolving frontend codebase so product teams can build confidently on top of shared foundations. Canvas, collaboration, and real-time systems Work on the architecture behind n8n’s canvas-based workflow building experience. Build and improve real-time collaboration capabilities using approaches such as WebSockets, CRDTs, or multiplayer synchronization patterns. Design frontend systems with correctness, accessibility, and user experience in mind, especially for complex interactive workflows. Performance and rendering foundations Improve rendering performance, runtime behavior, and responsiveness across complex workflow-building experiences. Use performance measurement, profiling, and optimization techniques to identify bottlenecks and improve user experience. Contribute to web worker orchestration and other frontend infrastructure that helps n8n scale to more complex use cases. Technical contribution and collaboration Drive technical decisions through clear proposals, RFCs, and collaborative engineering discussions. Partner closely with product engineers, QA, DX, Security, Staff Architects, and the open-source community to ensure platform changes integrate smoothly. Support peers through code reviews, pairing, mentoring, and knowledge sharing. REQUIREMENTS Must-haves 🧱 Complex frontend systems: You’ve built architecture-heavy frontend products such as canvas-based tools, real-time applications, collaborative editors, or similarly complex interfaces. ⚡ Performance and rendering depth: You can measure, debug, and improve runtime performance in large frontend applications. 🛠️ TypeScript expertise: You have strong TypeScript frontend experience and are comfortable working in a large, evolving codebase. 🏗️ Architectural ownership: You’ve owned meaningful frontend systems, led migrations, or re-architected complex areas of a product. 🧠 Systems thinking mindset: You think in trade-offs, correctness, platform contracts, maintainability, and long-term scalability. 🤝 Collaboration: You communicate clearly, work cross-functionally, and enjoy enabling other engineers rather than building in isolation. 🧹 Pragmatic engineering: You’re excited by refactoring, modularization, tech debt reduction, and improving existing systems over time. Nice-to-haves 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Real-time collaboration: You have experience with CRDTs, multiplayer systems, collaborative editors, or real-time communication layers. 🧵 Frontend platform patterns: You’ve worked with plugin systems, extension architectures, micro-frontends, or web worker orchestration. 🖥️ Vue experience: You have experience with Vue or are excited to work deeply in a Vue-based frontend codebase. 🌍 Open-source experience: You’ve contributed to or maintained open-source software and understand public API contracts and backward compatibility. 🧰 Developer tools or workflow products: You’ve worked on workflow engines, developer tools, infrastructure-adjacent SaaS, or other technical products. 📈 Large-scale SaaS exposure: You’ve worked on systems with meaningful scale, complexity, or long-term maintainability challenges. ☁️ Multi-deployment awareness: You’ve built products that work across cloud, single-tenant, or self-hosted environments. 🔭 Observability mindset: You care about instrumentation, debugging, rollout safety, and making complex systems easier to operate. Why join us? At n8n, you’ll work on the frontend foundations behind a widely-used open-source automation platform — from the canvas experience and real-time collaboration layer to the performance, modularity, and platform contracts that help 80+ product engineers build faster. Your work will shape how technical teams and builders around the world create, scale, and collaborate on workflows across cloud and self-hosted deployments. You’ll join a remote-first engineering org at a high-growth stage, as our Platform Engineering team scales from 8 to 17+ people by the end of 2026. That means you’ll have real architectural ownership, high visibility, and the opportunity to influence frontend standards, technical direction, and the culture of a team being built now. Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on? Apply now — and help us build the future of automation. n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work. Our company language is English. You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n ( https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35 ). Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future. Benefits Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay. Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity. Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge: Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are. US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are. raw.description:

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to design and evolve the frontend platform foundations that power n8n’s workflow-building experience, enabling product engineers and the open-source community to ship complex, reliable, and high-performance user experiences across cloud and self-hosted deployments.

As part of the team, you’ll take ownership of core frontend platform domains and help shape the architecture behind one of the most flexible automation products in the market:

Frontend platform architecture

  • Own and evolve core frontend platform primitives that make n8n’s workflow builder scalable, extensible, and maintainable.

  • Strengthen platform contracts such as plugin systems, extension points, and frontend developer experience.

  • Help modularize a large, evolving frontend codebase so product teams can build confidently on top of shared foundations.

Canvas, collaboration, and real-time systems

  • Build and improve real-time collaboration capabilities using approaches such as WebSockets, CRDTs, or multiplayer synchronization patterns.

  • Design frontend systems with correctness, accessibility, and user experience in mind, especially for complex interactive workflows.

Performance and rendering foundations

  • Improve rendering performance, runtime behavior, and responsiveness across complex workflow-building experiences.

  • Use performance measurement, profiling, and optimization techniques to identify bottlenecks and improve user experience.

  • Contribute to web worker orchestration and other frontend infrastructure that helps n8n scale to more complex use cases.

Technical contribution and collaboration

  • Drive technical decisions through clear proposals, RFCs, and collaborative engineering discussions.

  • Partner closely with product engineers, QA, DX, Security, Staff Architects, and the open-source community to ensure platform changes integrate smoothly.

  • Support peers through code reviews, pairing, mentoring, and knowledge sharing.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🧱 Complex frontend systems: You’ve built architecture-heavy frontend products such as canvas-based tools, real-time applications, collaborative editors, or similarly complex interfaces.

  • ⚡ Performance and rendering depth: You can measure, debug, and improve runtime performance in large frontend applications.

  • 🛠️ TypeScript expertise: You have strong TypeScript frontend experience and are comfortable working in a large, evolving codebase.

  • 🏗️ Architectural ownership: You’ve owned meaningful frontend systems, led migrations, or re-architected complex areas of a product.

  • 🧠 Systems thinking mindset: You think in trade-offs, correctness, platform contracts, maintainability, and long-term scalability.

  • 🤝 Collaboration: You communicate clearly, work cross-functionally, and enjoy enabling other engineers rather than building in isolation.

  • 🧹 Pragmatic engineering: You’re excited by refactoring, modularization, tech debt reduction, and improving existing systems over time.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Real-time collaboration: You have experience with CRDTs, multiplayer systems, collaborative editors, or real-time communication layers.

  • 🧵 Frontend platform patterns: You’ve worked with plugin systems, extension architectures, micro-frontends, or web worker orchestration.

  • 🖥️ Vue experience: You have experience with Vue or are excited to work deeply in a Vue-based frontend codebase.

  • 🌍 Open-source experience: You’ve contributed to or maintained open-source software and understand public API contracts and backward compatibility.

  • 🧰 Developer tools or workflow products: You’ve worked on workflow engines, developer tools, infrastructure-adjacent SaaS, or other technical products.

  • 📈 Large-scale SaaS exposure: You’ve worked on systems with meaningful scale, complexity, or long-term maintainability challenges.

  • ☁️ Multi-deployment awareness: You’ve built products that work across cloud, single-tenant, or self-hosted environments.

  • 🔭 Observability mindset: You care about instrumentation, debugging, rollout safety, and making complex systems easier to operate.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll work on the frontend foundations behind a widely-used open-source automation platform — from the canvas experience and real-time collaboration layer to the performance, modularity, and platform contracts that help 80+ product engineers build faster. Your work will shape how technical teams and builders around the world create, scale, and collaborate on workflows across cloud and self-hosted deployments.

You’ll join a remote-first engineering org at a high-growth stage, as our Platform Engineering team scales from 8 to 17+ people by the end of 2026. That means you’ll have real architectural ownership, high visibility, and the opportunity to influence frontend standards, technical direction, and the culture of a team being built now.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Backend + Frontend)
description: Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call. Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a  Senior Full-Stack Engineer  to build the platform that catches data problems before they become business problems. About Us Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing. Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo. The Role You'll work across our entire stack: Java backend services and the TypeScript/Angular frontend that power Soda Cloud. We're product engineers, not ticket-takers: you'll own features end-to-end, talk to users, shape the design with your PM, and ship from database to UI without waiting for hand-offs. We also build agentically: AI coding agents are part of the daily workflow here, not an experiment on the side. What You'll Do Build features end-to-end: backend APIs, database changes, frontend UI, and ship them to production yourself. Design and implement backend services for a multi-tenant SaaS platform. Work with relational databases (MySQL): schema design, query optimization, data modeling. Build frontend features that are clean, fast, and don't get in the way. Optimize performance across the stack and write tests at every layer (unit, integration, e2e). Build agentic features into the product: LLM-powered workflows that help users find, understand, and fix data issues. Improve our systems for agentic development: agent instructions, skills, and the test feedback loops that make agents effective across the codebase. Work directly with product, design, and customers to decide what to build. Your opinion matters here. Hiring Process CV screen 20-minute phone screen First technical interview (45 min) Second technical interview (60 min) Culture fit (45 min) We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly. Requirements You Should Have 5+ years building software at a product company : you've owned meaningful parts of a real production system. Strong Java : REST APIs, database interactions, async processing. TypeScript and a modern frontend framework : Angular preferred (it's what powers Soda Cloud). Frontend fundamentals : complex UIs, component architecture, state management, performance, responsive design. Solid SQL in a backend context : schema design, query optimization, migrations in production. We run MySQL and ClickHouse. Testing as a habit : you actually write tests, including e2e (Cypress/Playwright). Architectural judgment : you design APIs from the consumer's perspective and understand how those choices shape data flow and latency across the stack. DevOps fluency : containers, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, comfortable on Linux. Agentic engineering : you ship production code with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) in the loop, and you know how to direct them well while keeping the quality bar high. Independence : you don't need hand-holding in a distributed, async team across 12+ countries. Fluent English. Good to Have Multi-tenant SaaS at scale; high-growth startup experience. An eye for design: you can spot a misaligned pixel. Python: our data engineering stack runs on it. Experience building agentic workflows into the product: LLM-powered features, tool-using agents, or AI-driven automation shipped to real users. Data quality, data management, data observability, or ML monitoring industry experience. Benefits What We Offer Compensation €85,000-120,000/year + equity. Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one. All the tokens you need, across all frontier models. Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement. A team of senior engineers who ship, across 12+ countries. Our Values We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions. ❤️ Why you will love to join Soda Be part of a transformation : data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it. Ownership from day one : if you see a bottleneck, you remove it. International culture : colleagues in 12+ countries. Work on your own terms : fully remote, flexible hours. 😡 What you might not love Rapidly changing priorities : our roadmap can pivot quickly. Kein Problem – wir freuen uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Unsere Benefits bei CMBlu Energy AG für Dich:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>VSOP-Programm</strong>: Mit unserem Virtual Stock Option Program (VSOP) kannst du am Erfolg der CMBlu Energy AG teilhaben und vom Wachstum unseres Unternehmens profitieren.</li> <li><strong>Deutschland-Ticket</strong>: Wir übernehmen<strong> </strong>komplett das<strong> </strong>Deutschland-Bahn-Ticket, damit du nachhaltig und komfortabel reisen kannst.</li> <li><strong>Bedeutungsvolle Arbeit</strong>: Arbeite an der Entwicklung unserer innovativen Organic-SolidFlow-Batterie, die einen wichtigen Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Energienutzung und -speicherung leisten.</li> <li><strong>Remote-Arbeit</strong>: Abhängig vom Aufgabenbereich bieten wir die Möglichkeit,<strong> </strong>teilweise remote zu arbeiten, wenn es die Position zulässt.</li> <li><strong>Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten</strong>: Wir fördern deine persönliche und berufliche Weiterentwicklung durch regelmäßige Schulungen und spannende Projekte.</li> <li><strong>Faires Gehalt</strong>: Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges und faires Gehalt, das deine Leistung anerkennt.</li> <li><strong>Unsere Werte</strong>: Bei CMBlu Energy AG stehen Verlässlichkeit, Innovation und Unermüdlichkeit im Mittelpunkt unserer Zusammenarbeit.</li> </ul> <p>Wenn du bereit bist, dich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen und Innovationen voranzutreiben, wollen wir von dir hören! Bei CMBlu Energy AG arbeitest du mit einem leidenschaftlichen Team zusammen, das sich für Spitzenleistungen und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen einsetzt.</p> <p><br>Bewirb dich jetzt und sei ein Teil unserer spannenden Reise. Junior Engineer (AI)

(€60K – €75K)

About the Role

You will join our data team as an AI-native engineer focused on automating data flows and building self-service data access for the business. The focus is on debugging and improving automations, building agents, and reducing the number of ad hoc requests that land on the data team's desk.

What You'll Do

  • Debug and maintain existing data automations

  • Build agents that handle repeatable data tasks end to end

  • Work across multiple data sources and systems, making sense of fragmented data

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand where manual data work is slowing them down, and build solutions

Must-Haves

  • Hands-on experience building with AI agents or LLM tools

  • Solid coding fundamentals

  • A business mindset: interest in how the work connects to what the company needs, not just the technical build

  • Curiosity and a strong learning mindset, especially around AI tools and trends

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with Python or Node.js in a production or personal-project setting

  • Experience with automation/orchestration tools such as n8n

  • Exposure to SQL or working with structured data

What We Value

  • An AI-native approach: you use AI tools daily and think in terms of what agents can take off your plate

  • Proactive problem-solving: going to people, understanding their workflow, and suggesting a better way

  • Comfort with ambiguity and evolving requirements

Why Almedia?

  • Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success.

  • Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

  • Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

  • Deep knowledge of licensing across the recorded music and publishing industries.

  • Leadership and management experience.

description: About Andela: At Andela, we know brilliance is evenly distributed around the world, but opportunity is not. Are you exceptional and hungry to work in a scaling business through transformation and growth? Join us and change the world. Job Summary As the Marketing Manager, Europe, you will be responsible for designing and executing the programs that build pipeline, strengthen brand presence, and accelerate revenue across the region. You will own end-to-end regional marketing strategy with a heavy emphasis on field events, account-based marketing (ABM), and pipeline generating campaigns that directly support the European sales team. You will operate as a collaborative partner to specialized marketers across Andela's global team — including growth, content, design, PR, and client marketing— bringing their capabilities to bear in the European market context. This role reports into the Senior Director of Marketing GTM Strategy and is based in the UK within a commutable distance to London. Exceptional Leadership As an Andelan, you'll serve as a role model for the rest of the company — you do not need to manage people to be a leader at Andela! Think about the feedback your peers typically give you — if it usually sounds like the below, we want to hear from you. Low ego, low drama: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea. One team mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone. Great listener, hungry for feedback: You're always seeking to improve — our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen. Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you. Team-player: You roll up your sleeves and get scrappy. You do this by proactively collaborating with your team while actively engaging in important details that matter. Business problem solver: You're not just a functional expert; you consistently get praise for approaching your function through the lens of solving business problems. Key Responsibilities Regional Event Strategy & Execution Own the end-to-end planning and execution of European field events — including owned events, sponsored industry conferences, roundtables, and executive dinners — aligned to pipeline and revenue goals. Build and maintain a European events calendar, managing logistics, vendor relationships, budget, and post-event follow-up to ensure measurable ROI. Partner with the sales team to ensure event audiences reflect target account lists, and that every event ties to a clear pipeline outcome. Track and report on event performance including attendee quality, influenced pipeline, and cost-per-opportunity. Account-Based Marketing (ABM) Partner with the Growth Marketing team to design and execute ABM programs targeting high-priority European accounts in collaboration with sales leadership. Use account intelligence to both inform campaigns and support the regional sellers.
