We don’t just pay claims; we help our customers prevent them. We now insure hundreds of fleets in the UK, including the likes of Amazon, DPD, Uber and Bolt.

We've now raised over £50M and our goal is to become the leading insurance company for connected and autonomous vehicles, and we're building a world-class team to help us get there.

We're an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger.

THE ROLE 

At Flock, we're transforming the motor fleet insurance landscape with cutting-edge technology and data-driven insights. As a Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter, you'll play a pivotal role in our mission to deliver smarter, safer, and more cost-effective insurance solutions. You'll leverage advanced analytics and AI to assess risk, optimise underwriting processes, and create tailored policies that meet the unique needs of our clients. Your expertise will drive our growth, helping us build a future where innovation and excellence in insurance are the norm. If you're passionate about making an impact, thrive in a dynamic startup environment, and are ready to lead the charge in redefining fleet insurance, we want you on our team!

WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE:

You'll have the autonomy to manage and develop a large business portfolio, mentor junior team members, and significantly contribute to team targets. You'll help unlock growth into new market segments, offering insurance solutions for emerging mobility trends, and support our ambition to become one of the UK's largest fleet MGAs. Your expertise will drive growth and innovation, positioning us at the forefront of the fleet insurance industry. You'll also work with AI in the underwriting process itself, using it to pull risk data out of submissions and triage cases faster, which leaves your time for the judgement calls that need an experienced underwriter.

WHAT YOU’ll BRING TO FLOCK

ESSENTIAL

  • Extensive experience underwriting motor fleet insurance 

  • Track record of building strong and supportive relationships with insurance brokers

  • The ability to collate data and provide support to our Head of Underwriting to enable them to monitor and analyse the portfolio

  • Provide feedback and continuously improve the process for gathering risk information from our clients, in order to ensure frictionless quoting and onboarding for all clients and brokers

  • Identify and surface to our Underwriting Manager areas where we can improve our policy wording and coverage

  • Follow rapidly evolving market trends, continuously refurbishing your knowledge of cutting-edge products and services in the Motor Fleet

  • Actively train and develop members of the Underwriting and operations teams and to help promote Underwriting knowledge across Flock

  • Comfortable using AI in underwriting work, for example extracting and checking risk information or speeding up quoting, while keeping your own judgement on every decision

PREFERABLE

  • Experience in dealing with large corporate customers 

  • ACII qualified or working towards

  • Experience of working closely with product teams to ensure product, process and customer journey enhancements are included within the product roadmap

WHAT WE OFFER (in addition to a competitive salary)

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏩 (including Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

At Flock, we typically follow a hybrid working model involving a minimum of 3 days per week spent in the office, which is based in Central London, a few minutes walk from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Please note if your role involves visit to client sites and broker offices, then this can be substituted for office days.

ONE LAST THING..

Authenticity is important to us. We value the unique qualities and experiences you bring. So if you apply, just be your genuine self. It's who we want!

In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3078 - Strategy Director, Media Strategy - UK</strong></p> <p>We're seeking a strategic thinker with expertise in media effectiveness and storytelling to join our team at T&amp;P. Your role will involve shaping client communications through insightful strategies, fostering innovation, and maintaining effective measurement processes.</p> <p>This role will include one of our integrated clients and the successful candidate will be the senior strategy practitioner. As such, it is ideally suited for a strategist who is keen to develop a broader skillset than media alone, as well as gain experience managing senior client stakeholders.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>Whilst your average to do list will vary from day to day, typical responsibilities will include:</p> <ul> <li>Leading strategic responses, narratives for pitches as well as delivering genuine data-driven insight to client teams</li> <li>Delivering key internal strategic workstreams, planning and insight training as well as encouraging agency creativity and innovation</li> <li>Present work in agency forums, lead agency brainstorms as well as identify and develop award entries</li> <li>Staying up to date with trends and sharing this with strategy teams alongside contributing to thought pieces and external events</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>We are most interested in your ability to articulate the client’s challenge succinctly and turn that into actionable instructions for media planning teams. The skillset and experience you may have had to get to this point may vary but in general will include:</li> <ul> <li>Both ATL and Digital media channel knowledge</li> <li>The gravitas to be a trusted strategic partner to key clients</li> <li>Ability to build strong relationships across the agency</li> <li>Understanding of effectiveness best practice and a willing to improvise to deliver competitive advantage</li> <li>Most importantly, you will be curious, clear and creative in your thinking, writing and speaking.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. </p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.</p> <p>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Director, Planning
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3118 - Director, Planning - UK</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>This is an incredibly exciting opportunity to join our digital-first agency and lead one of the UK's most vibrant, fast-paced, and culturally loved brands: <strong>ITV</strong>.</p> <p>ITV is an absolute powerhouse within the UK’s media and entertainment landscape. They run a highly diverse portfolio of campaigns that shape the national conversation. Your mission is to partner directly with ITV’s senior marketing and strategy teams to build their consumer-facing brand, launch their biggest, most talked-about TV shows—from blockbuster dramas and live sports to cultural phenomena like&nbsp;<em>Love Island</em>—and aggressively drive digital customer acquisition to scale Monthly Active Users (MAUs) on&nbsp;<strong>ITVX</strong>.</p> <p>As the senior strategic and operational lead on this flagship account, you will tackle the thrilling challenges of digital, data, and ad-tech integration to power marketing communications that create a true competitive advantage. This role offers a massive focus on innovation and digital excellence, providing a brilliant opportunity to drive our signature&nbsp;<strong>“wholebrain”</strong>&nbsp;planning philosophy across a high-profile, culturally relevant brand.</p> <p>You will be part of a senior leadership team, working closely with the Managing Partner, Partners, and Digital Directors. You will also collaborate on cross-portfolio agency workstreams and help shape the future of our broader agency product.</p> <p><strong>The Team:</strong>&nbsp;You will lead and inspire a talented, integrated team, typically consisting of Planning Senior Associate Directors, Account Directors, Account Managers, and supporting Planner and Executive resource.</p> <p><strong>Reporting Line:</strong>&nbsp;This role reports directly to the Client Partner.</p> <p><strong>Key Deliverables &amp; Objectives</strong></p> <p><strong>Client Leadership &amp; Strategic Excellence</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Brand &amp; Growth Delivery:</strong>&nbsp;Take overall responsibility for the quality of the work exiting the agency. Ensure all media plans are first-class, insight-led, and masterfully balance high-impact show launches with sophisticated digital acquisition strategies to drive ITVX streaming growth.</li> <li><strong>Client Satisfaction &amp; PRF Delivery:</strong>&nbsp;Establish trusted, long-term relationships with senior ITV stakeholders. Deliver a proactive relationship-management strategy to ensure consistently high satisfaction scores, successfully unlocking performance-related fee (PRF) targets.</li> <li><strong>Adoption of Next-Gen &amp; A.I. Planning Tools:</strong>&nbsp;Act as an internal pioneer for the agency's proprietary planning systems. Drive the integration of AI-powered solutions and automated planning software across the account to deliver superior, data-driven planning results.</li> <li><strong>Award-Winning Work:</strong>&nbsp;Champion breakthrough creative thinking across the team, aiming to deliver high-quality, innovative campaigns that are regularly entered and shortlisted for major industry awards (e.g.,&nbsp;<em>Media Week</em>,&nbsp;<em>Campaign</em>).</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong><strong>Commercial &amp; Financial Stewardship</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Financial Forecasting &amp; Governance:</strong>&nbsp;Take full accountability for the financial health of the ITV business. Maintain highly accurate internal revenue and spend forecasting with minimal variance, keeping meticulous trackers of budget adjustments.</li> <li><strong>Working Capital Management:</strong>&nbsp;Partner with finance teams to ensure seamless client billing, contract compliance, and prompt resolution of queries, maintaining debtors and unbilled accounts within strict corporate tolerance limits.</li> <li><strong>Diversified Revenue Growth:</strong>&nbsp;Identify organic commercial opportunities to cross-sell and sell-in specialised agency services and managed partnerships, driving Year-on-Year growth in out-of-scope (OOS) revenue.</li> <li><strong>Contractual Target Management:</strong>&nbsp;Oversee &amp; contribute towards the successful delivery of complex contractual media targets (including barter, contra, and trading commitments), ensuring continuous monthly tracking is in place to mitigate under- or over-delivery.</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong><strong>People &amp; Team Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Talent Development &amp; Succession:</strong>&nbsp;Build, motivate, and maintain a high-performing planning team. Ensure all team members have clear career growth plans mapped to planning craft KPIs, alongside robust succession planning.</li> <li><strong>High-Potential (HiPo) Retention:</strong>&nbsp;Foster a supportive, inclusive, and collaborative team culture, aiming to achieve industry-leading retention rates amongst top-tier talent.</li> <li><strong>Integrated Activation:</strong>&nbsp;Ensure the planning team is closely aligned with internal specialist buying and investment departments to guarantee ITV's trading commitments are executed flawlessly.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Agency Growth &amp; Thought Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Category Thought Leadership:</strong>&nbsp;Actively engage with the wider agency planning community, positioning yourself as the internal go-to expert for the entertainment and streaming category through regular, inspiring thought leadership presentations.</li> <li><strong>New Business Engine:</strong> Contribute to the growth of WPP Media by actively participating in and leading high-value, strategic new business pitches.<strong>&nbsp;</strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Our Core Values:</strong>&nbsp;You must be&nbsp;<strong>All In</strong>&nbsp;(deeply passionate about the media industry, ITV, and creating standout work),&nbsp;<strong>Action-Orientated</strong>&nbsp;(thriving in a fast-paced environment where plans can change at the speed of live TV), and committed to&nbsp;<strong>Personal Growth</strong>&nbsp;(for yourself and your team).</li> <li><strong>Proven Leadership Experience:</strong>&nbsp;Extensive experience leading large, multi-level planning and account teams within a media agency, managing high-profile consumer brands.</li> <li><strong>Robust Communications Planning:</strong>&nbsp;A deep, intuitive understanding of communication planning across offline, digital, and performance channels, with experience using data and cultural insights to drive tangible business outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Digital &amp; Tech Literacy:</strong>&nbsp;A strong working knowledge of the digital media ecosystem, including experience adopting and scaling automated planning tools and AI-driven platforms.</li> <li><strong>Excellent Commercial Acumen:</strong>&nbsp;Strong experience managing large budgets, agency profitability, contractual SLAs, and complex commercial arrangements (such as barter and contra deals).</li> <li><strong>A Passion for Entertainment:</strong>&nbsp;A genuine, infectious curiosity for the broadcast, digital video, and streaming entertainment landscape. You are someone who loves TV, pop culture, and understands how to connect audiences with the content they love.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.</p> <p>We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.</p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in our state-of-the-art WPP Southbank campus around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p><em>Please note this is a UK-based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;#LI-Promoted</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Hawk-Eye has built a business on getting things exactly right, first time, under pressure, with everyone watching. Payroll works to the same standard. It's the process nobody notices until it goes wrong, and making sure that never happens is what this role exists to do.

We're keen to move quickly. Desirable

The Role

We're hiring a Tax Compliance Manager to take ownership of tax compliance and reporting across our growing global entity structure. This role is based in our New York City office.

You'll work closely with external advisors, finance colleagues, and cross-functional teams to ensure our compliance obligations are met to a high standard across all jurisdictions, while supporting the wider tax team on new market launches, product rollouts, and planning projects as the business scales.

This is a brilliant opportunity for someone looking to own tax compliance in a fast-scaling fintech — gaining broad exposure across a range of countries and entity types, working directly with senior stakeholders, and building a deep understanding of how tax supports a business as it grows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Global Tax Compliance: Manage end-to-end tax filings across all group entities, coordinating with external advisors to ensure accurate, timely returns in every jurisdiction.

  • Manage Outsourced Providers: Own the relationship with third-party compliance providers — setting scopes, reviewing deliverables, and holding quality standards across regions.

  • Lead Tax Reporting: Support the preparation of tax provisions, deferred tax calculations, and disclosures for statutory accounts and group reporting (IFRS and/or US GAAP).

  • Support New Market Launches: Ensure tax compliance requirements are embedded from day one whenever the business enters a new market or launches a new product.

  • Contribute to Tax Projects: Work alongside the wider tax team on transfer pricing documentation, group restructurings, and assessments of legislative change.

  • Build Better Processes: Develop and improve internal tax controls, reporting, and processes as the function matures and the entity structure grows.

  • Stay Ahead of Tax Developments: Monitor changes in key jurisdictions and feed these into the team's wider planning.

  • Liaise with Auditors & Tax Authorities: Act as a key point of contact for external auditors, tax authorities, and advisors on compliance queries, audits, and ad-hoc filings.

  • Monitor Effective Tax Rates: Prepare and maintain current and deferred tax reconciliations, tracking effective tax rates across the group.

What We're Looking For

  • Qualified CPA, or equivalent professional qualification.

  • At least 5 years of relevant tax experience, whether in practice (Big 4 or mid-tier) or a combination of practice and in-house.

  • Strong grounding in corporate tax compliance and reporting, with exposure to international or multi-jurisdictional work.

  • Comfortable managing external advisors and reviewing outsourced deliverables to a high standard.

  • Solid understanding of tax accounting and provisioning under US GAAP and/or IFRS — both is a plus; one is required.

  • Experience with transfer pricing compliance or documentation is a plus, but not essential.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or a high-growth startup environment is a plus.

Who You Are

  • Ownership mindset — you take responsibility, follow through, and move things forward without heavy oversight.

  • Communication — you explain tax matters clearly to non-specialists and know how to land a complex point simply.

  • Comfort with ambiguity — you make practical recommendations even when the answer isn't clear-cut.

  • Curiosity — you have a genuine interest in how tax supports a fast-growing, international business.
